fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-08-16 states that the complainant was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony in Tiruppur after a dispute over a parking issue, on 2025-08-16 around 22:15 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Malathi Ammal (9000000345). Dinesh Subramani was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. Karthik Velan (mobile 9000000188) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Several persons reportedly attacked the victim in a secluded stretch.
